title: Session namer
summary: Names each session with a short project key and title, such as "WEB fix login".
details: Each session gets a short name such as WEB fix login, built from a project key and what the session is about. It is for you if you keep several sessions open and want to tell them apart at a glance. It copies a hook script and adds a UserPromptSubmit entry to your settings; the script runs on prompts and makes a small background Haiku call, which costs a little usage.

values.ask: Folder that holds your projects (leave empty for Desktop/Projects in your home folder)
Project folder name (lower case) to a key of at most 4 capital letters, as JSON, for example {"webshop":"SHOP"} (leave {} to derive keys from folder names)

risk: Runs on prompts and starts a small background Haiku call to name each session, which costs a little usage.
